newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee regains lost ground, closes firm.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee regains lost ground, closes firm.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee clawed its way back to close near opening levels on Wednesday after a spell of early volatility when speculators drove down the currency, dealers said.
The rupee closed a 58.25 to the dollar after opening at 58.26, they said.
"Speculators sold the rupee down to 58.15 in early trade at which levels sellers moved out," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates were steady at 7.5 perent with the market well offered, he said.
